summary: GD Culture Group Ltd filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of 259,301,306 common shares at $0.021 per share, raising ~$5.45 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed on June 24, 2026, with Univest Securities as placement agent receiving a 7% cash fee. Net proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. The filing is a routine capital raise via an effective shelf registration (Form S-3), not a special situation. No special-situation characteristics such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns are present.
